criteria: Old2179 at1171: fully automatic mask prompts from the two fixed past boxes, fixed SAM first-only memory, recall>=0.5 and FPR<=0.1; primary automatic source YOLO26n-seg, paired detector-box SAM is the alternate. No switching after results.
External fixed day and night clips: every visible query from automatic YOLO initial mask has recall>=0.5 and FPR<=0.1; edge with no known positive reported separately.
Recovery of manual comparator on all 14 queries exactly; no query detections, future masks, or fallback to manual when automatic initial mask absent; match all arrays to exact input sources.
design: Fixed prior boxes, exact same SAM propagation, only trusted conditioning frames; three initial sources: manual cores, YOLO candidate with highest positive bbox-IoU (no minimum tuned), official SAM2 box prompt. No frame-wise query boxes. No-mask YOLO: skip reference, predict empty if none. All query annotations evaluation only. SAM box and SAM mask prompting differ in official encoding; this diagnoses the whole initialization pathway, not prompt encoding alone.
scope: Known clips, generality exploratory; prior target reference identity assumed, no GT used at query time. No tracking metrics.
